acceptance_criteria.description: The container receives a pinned and reachable uv or uvx implementation, preferably preinstalled in the immutable image.
The official verifier is invoked inside the task container and its retained result is independently inspectable.
Dependency or verifier bootstrap failures remain verifier or infrastructure failures and are not converted to Agent scores.

objective: Make the official Terminal-Bench verifier dependency path deterministic inside the task container; host uv or uvx availability is not sufficient and verifier bootstrap failure must never be scored as an Agent failure.
title: Make the task-container verifier uvx path deterministic
